date_in_source: Header specifies C6/PGE6.0.1; creation 2013-08-01; retrieved through C6.1 catalog link
locator: Scientific Data Sets; FireMask; QA; MaxFRP; sample
facts: FireMask uint8: at most eight daily 1200x1200 planes, class range0..9, missing fill0.
Daily class aggregation chooses maximum class, with clear water taking precedence over cloud over water.
MaxFRP type declarations disagree between table and prose; do not build decoder from that ambiguity.
sample is fire-only uint16 sample position0..1353; nonfire sample0 does not identify a unique acquisition.
